--- layout: default type_slug: donut title: Donut Chart in C# — Ring Charts with Centre Labels as SVG nav_title: Donut Chart description: Build donut charts in C# with DonutHole and DonutCenter — a total in the middle, labelled slices around it, rendered as self-contained SVG. permalink: /chart/types/donut/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} // Donut with center label string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .AsPie() .Title("Revenue by Region") .Size(620, 460) .Labels("North America","Europe","Asia-Pacific","Rest of World") .Legend(l => l.AtBottom()) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .Add("Revenue %", new double[] { 42, 28, 22, 8 }, cfg => { cfg.DonutHole(0.55); // 55 % hole radius cfg.DataLabel.Show().Radius(1.0).Format("{value}%"); cfg.DonutCenter.Show().Title("Total"); })) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
